briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and xAI Grok-4 escalate frontier race amid compute shortages

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid model releases with Orion-2 and Grok-4 showing 25% gains on agentic benchmarks. Regulatory pressure mounts in EU and US while compute bottlenecks slow smaller players.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed Orion-2 internally with advanced reasoning; xAI released Grok-4; DeepSeek-V3.5 closed gap on coding tasks. Meta's Llama-4 preview leaked showing competitive multimodal performance.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits delays; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100 clusters in Texas and Arizona. TSMC reports 3nm AI chip yields improving.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a closed lab or an open consortium by 2028?
